The specification describes features for Spring XD (or a similar stream processing framework based on Spring).
User stories:
U1: Clean up message bus resources (queues/topics) when a stream is destroyed.
U2: Clean up stale queues/topics associated with the stream when destroyed.
U3: Option to edit deployed/undeployed stream without destroying it.
U4: Include deployment manifest from a file instead of inline properties.
U5: Reference architectures built on Spring XD for field engineers (documentation/samples).
U6: Optional trace as inline deployment properties for stream (module.http.trace, etc.) using wiretap.
U7: Optional arbitrary "side channels" created when creating a module (tap channel within a flow).
U8: Study taxi trips based on a stream of trip reports (DEBS 2015 Grand Challenge) using Spring XD (POC/evaluation).

1. Break down into activities.
2. State technical/design decisions and assumptions.
3. Provide most likely effort for each activity in workdays.
4. Calculate total.

Activities:
1. Requirements Analysis & Design: Analyze U1-U8, design stream lifecycle, manifest loading, tracing, side channels. (3 days)
2. Stream Lifecycle & Resource Cleanup (U1, U2): Implement cleanup of message bus resources and stale queues/topics on stream destruction. (4 days)
3. Stream Editing (U3): Implement update/edit functionality for deployed/undeployed streams without destroying. (5 days)
4. Manifest File Loading (U4): Implement parsing and loading of deployment manifest from files. (2 days)
5. Module Tracing & Wiretap (U6): Implement optional trace inline properties, configure wiretap for modules. (4 days)
6. Side Channels / Taps (U7): Implement creation of arbitrary side channels within a flow. (5 days)
7. Reference Architectures (U5): Create documentation and sample projects for reference architectures. (3 days)
8. Taxi Trips POC (U8): Implement stream processing for DEBS 2015 challenge using Spring XD. (6 days)
9. Testing & Integration: Unit, integration, and end-to-end testing of all features. (5 days)
10. Documentation & Deployment: Finalize documentation, prepare deployment scripts. (2 days)

Total: 3+4+5+2+4+5+3+6+5+2 = 39 days.

- Use Spring XD core APIs for stream and module lifecycle management.

- Extend the stream deployment model to support side channels (U7) by modifying the module deployment context.
- For U8, use Spring XD's source/processor/sink modules to handle the DEBS 2015 data stream.

Assumptions:

- Access to the DEBS 2015 dataset for U8.

Use Spring Integration's GlobalWiretap configuration to implement the optional trace functionality for modules.
Extend the module deployment context to support the creation of arbitrary side channels within a flow.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories U1-U8, design the stream lifecycle modifications, manifest loading architecture, tracing/wiretap integration, and side channel architecture.
Implement the cleanup of message bus resources and stale queues/topics associated with a stream when it is destroyed.
Implement the functionality to edit deployment properties of deployed/undeployed streams without requiring a full destroy and recreate cycle.
Develop the capability to load deployment manifests from external files instead of requiring inline properties.
Implement optional trace inline deployment properties for streams, configuring wiretaps for specific modules or wildcards to track stage progress.
Implement the creation of optional arbitrary side channels within a flow, allowing taps to be created inside a module's context.
Create documentation and sample projects capturing domain-specific reference architectures built on Spring XD for field engineers.
Develop a proof of concept using Spring XD to study taxi trips based on a stream of trip reports from the DEBS 2015 Grand Challenge.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing of all implemented features (U1-U8).
Finalize user documentation, update deployment guides, and prepare the software increment for release.
